name: Prey For Comfort
source:
Annelie Althauser is A 10-year-old boy who has to navigate through life without a custodian.

Meeting an unexpected new friend named Warin provides a double-edged sword. Protection and guidance are vital for the young boy to survive, but is the proximity of a predator a valid risk to justify this safety? 

[Edited from [url=https://viruszeke.itch.io/prey-for-comfort]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
安妮莉·阿尔特豪瑟是一个10岁的男孩，她必须在没有监护人的情况下度过一生。

遇见一位名叫沃林的意想不到的新朋友是一把双刃剑。保护和指导对于小男孩的生存至关重要，但接近捕食者是否是证明这种安全合理的有效风险？
